faqs.question: How does Cekat.AI CRM help sales teams?
faqs.answer: Cekat.AI CRM helps sales teams capture and manage leads from multiple channels in one dashboard. Teams can track conversations, organize deals in pipelines, and focus on the leads most likely to convert.

faqs.question: How does Cekat.AI CRM support customer service teams?
faqs.answer: Cekat.AI CRM keeps all customer interactions in one place, so support teams can quickly understand the customer's history and context. This helps agents respond faster and resolve issues more efficiently.

faqs.question: Can I track where my leads come from?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cekat.AI CRM records the entry point of each lead, such as your website, ads, WhatsApp, or social channels. This helps you understand customer journeys and identify the channels that drive the most conversions.
